moves.comment: Black sacrifices material with 9...c6!!, maintaining the advantage (-1.36, Stockfish:16) after [pv:c6 dxc6 Nxc6 Nxc6 bxc6]. The move immediately targets the bishop on b5, keeping Black clearly better even at the cost of a line where White may win a rook and see its pawn structure improved. By contrast, 9...Kf8 leads to only a slight advantage for Black [pv:Kf8 O-O Qxh4 Bxf4 Bxe5], with White's king set to come under pressure deeper in the line—a slower payoff than the direct sacrificial plan.
